# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_FOR_BEARISH_REJECTION

**Filed:** 2026-08-20
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** quality_gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup currently requires VIX to be rising OR above 20 for entry. We hypothesize that tightening this to require VIX > 22 (indicating elevated fear) will improve trade quality by avoiding entries during low-VIX chop, reducing loser frequency without significantly impacting winner capture on J's anchor days.

## Mechanism

Add a new watcher quality gate `j_vwap_cont_put_vix_gate` equivalent for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON: evaluate VIX at entry bar; require VIX > 22.0. If condition fails, suppress the bearish entry signal. This gate runs in the watcher layer (like V14E_BEAR_ONLY_GATE) and only affects PUT entries. Exit logic and position management remain unchanged.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account would trade ~4 contracts (14% of headline P&L) due to 50% risk cap.
2. **Sample bias:** Testing on 6 J anchor days (small sample); selection method is fixed by OP-16 source-of-truth; overfit risk high if optimizing solely on these days.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q2 pending)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days: 4/29, 5/01, 5/04 pending)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: Suppressing all three J winners (-$1,542 edge_capture loss) 
   - Max drawdown: Potential -$1,200 if winners suppressed and losers increase due to forced re-entries 
   - Blow-up scenario: Repeated false VIX>22 signals during low-vol regimes causing whipsaw losses
6. **Concentration:** If 5/04 alone drives P&L (as in BEAR_SCORE_7_RELAXATION), top-1 day could exceed 80% of total P&L; requires monitoring.

## Pre-merge gate

- gym validators: `test_vix_filter_for_bearish_rejection.py` 10/10 PASS
- walk-forward OOS: 2025-Q3 to 2026-Q2 must show edge_capture >771 and Sharpe >1.0
- real-fills: Top 3 J days must show no winner-day loss >$50 and net edge_capture gain vs baseline
- anchor no-regression: Must not lose >$50 on any J winner day (4/29, 5/01, 5/04)

## Confidence

3 / 10 -- Low confidence due to high risk of suppressing J winners (4/29 and 5/01 VIX<22). Only viable if 5/04 winner sufficiently compensates and OOS shows robustness.
